title: phlegmariurus villonacensis
intro: Phlegmariurus villonacensis, commonly known as the Mexican polypody, is a species of epiphytic fern native to the tropical regions of Mexico and Central America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Phlegmariurus villonacensis include its ability to reduce inflammation, kill bacteria, and protect against oxidative stress. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
